question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **There**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct option to fill in the blank is "there."
 
• In this context, "**there**" is used as an adverb indicating a location or position.
 
• It emphasizes the idea that the truth exists or is present in a particular place, situation, or circumstance.
 
• The use of "**there**" in the sentence suggests that the truth is evident or accessible, and the speaker is highlighting its existence.
 
• It implies that the truth is not hidden and is available for observation or realization.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Their**" is a possessive determiner used to indicate ownership or possession by a group of people.
 
• "**Therein**" is an adverb that means in or into that place, circumstance, or thing. It is somewhat formal and is often used to refer to a location or a point in an argument or text.
 
• "**Here**" is an adverb indicating a location or position that is close to or at the present location of the speaker.
